messages:
emma_sales: Customer's vendor-risk team just asked for an EU-only data residency diagram, list of subprocessors with EU processing flags, and short SIG/CAIQ answers. POC kickoff next Tue, legal needs artifacts by EOD Fri. Can we pull canonical diagram + CSV and a 1-pager for SIG answers? cc @raj_security @lisa_solutions

lisa_solutions: I can produce a one-page diagram + bullets. Need confirmation on KMS option (customer-managed required?) and whether logs/metrics must go to customer-owned storage or can remain in our EU buckets.

raj_security: Their email said "customer-controlled keys" and "no replication outside EU". We'll state: TLS1.2+, AES-256 at rest, option for customer CMK in eu-central-1. Must mention audit log export and ability to disable third-party analytics by default.

mike_infra: Infrastructure summary: hosted EU stack in eu-central-1. Flow: client -> Redwood API (eu) -> inference pool (dedicated GPUs, eu) -> KV cache (regional redis) -> logs/usage -> S3 (eu) or push to customer S3. No cross-region replication unless customer signs DR. Small ascii: 

```
Client (EU) -> Redwood API (eu-central)
  -> Inference Hosts (dedicated GPUs, eu-central)
  -> KV cache / redis (eu-central)
  -> Logs / Events -> S3 (eu-central) OR customer S3
KMS: Redwood KMS (eu) OR Customer CMK (eu-central-1)
```

ana_legal: Please include the subprocessor list with a last-reviewed date and mark any vendors that process data outside EU or have US defaults (e.g., error reporting). Also include a short statement we can sign: "Redwood will not replicate customer content outside the EU unless expressly agreed in writing."

lisa_solutions: @mike_infra can you export subprocessors and flag EU-processing-capable vs US-only? I'll then annotate the diagram and produce PNG + bullets for SIG row-items.

mike_infra: Exporting now. Quick rundown (summary, not full CSV):
- AWS (eu-central-1) 3 hosting, eu-only unless DR enabled
- Datadog 3 EU processing mode available; contract addendum exists
- Sentry 3 has EU cluster option; older customers defaulted to US
- Third-party metrics vendor 3 optional, can be disabled for this customer
- KMS 3 AWS KMS, supports customer CMKs and cross-account access when configured
- Log storage 3 S3 in eu-central OR push to customer bucket (recommended for sensitive customers)

mike_infra: Also adding a short CMK setup snippet: 
```
1) Create CMK in customer AWS account (eu-central-1)
2) Add Redwood service principal to key policy
3) Provide key ARN; we'll request minimal kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt perms for inference
```

raj_security: Add these lines for SIG answers: key management options, retention & deletion policies (we honor customer deletion requests and provide data erasure workflows), access control (role-based access, MFA for admin ops), monitoring/audit (audit logs retained in-eu and exportable). Attach SOC2/ISO links.

emma_sales: Nice. Can we get: 1) PNG data flow, 2) subprocessors CSV with EU flags, 3) SIG Q&A bullets by Wednesday EOD? I need to send to prospect Thu morning. :pray:

lisa_solutions: Diagram draft uploaded to internal figma: https://intranet.redwood/diagrams/eu-dataflow-2026-draft (view-only). I'll export PNG once mike confirms flags.

mike_infra: CSV export link: https://internal.redwood/ops/subprocessors/2026-03-19-eu-subproc.csv. Flagged Sentry as "requires EU cluster" and Datadog "EU processing available; contract addendum in place". Attached KMS instructions.

ana_legal: Good. Emma, please include brief legal language in the RFP reply: "Redwood operates hosted EU-only deployments by default, supports customer-managed CMKs in eu-central-1, and will not replicate customer content outside the EU unless explicitly enabled in SOW." I'll review attachments once posted.

emma_sales: I'll assemble the packet and send draft to the prospect Thu AM. If they ask for POC specifics (e.g., log routing to customer bucket), I'll request bucket ARN + role during kickoff. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Artifacts exported and attached: https://files.redwood/export/1923456789/attachments.zip (link valid 7d)

mike_infra: quick follow-up: for the POC we recommend routing application logs to customer S3; if they want it, need bucket ARN and write role by SOW. Also be aware that enabling customer CMK requires key policy changes in their account.

emma_sales: noted. I'll ask about bucket + CMK during kickoff. Closing this thread unless further questions. :white_check_mark:
